name: Meme strats
note: Funny chaos calls from CS meme culture and Strat Roulette. Full classic catalog lives in Roulette mode.

strats.description: Knife out, tunnels, no plan B. All five go.
tasks: Knife to B tunnels immediately
One flash over for CT spawn
Smoke CT if anyone bought one
Plant for tunnels, keep swinging

strats.description: Five P90s into tunnels. Spray and take the site.
tasks: Everyone buys P90 (or closest SMG)
No stopping in tunnels
Spray car and platform together
Plant default, hold tunnels

strats.description: Five scouts. Jump peek mid doors and hope.
tasks: Buy SSG-08 only (plus kevlar if rich)
Jump peek mid doors as a pack
First tag goes B doors or A short
No rifle upgrades mid-round

strats.description: Stack five on B. They rush it every time anyway.
tasks: All five hold B (platform / car / tunnels)
Save util for tunnel entry
No mid peek until first contact
Rotate only after plant sound elsewhere

strats.description: No mid, no A. Whole team through apps.
tasks: All five through underpass / apps
One market window smoke
Flash site, trade into bench
Plant for apps, ignore palace

strats.description: If you can afford an AWP, buy one. Mid is a sniper fight.
tasks: Buy AWP if money allows (drop if not)
Stack mid window / top mid
First pick decides A or B hit
No rushing sites before a mid kill

strats.description: Everyone palace. Jump-spot ramp like old MM.
tasks: Five to palace, no ramp contact first
Jump peek ramp / connector
Flash in and commit
Plant default, hold palace

strats.description: One peeks window. Four hold off-angles and trade.
tasks: One designated window bait
Four hold off-angles (under / market / short)
Don't save the bait, just trade
Rotate on first sound after the bait dies

strats.description: No mid, no apps. Banana only. Flash and take B.
tasks: All five banana immediately
Throw every flash you own before sandbags
Molly / HE car if you have it
Plant for banana, swing CT together

strats.description: Chain flashes into B until they're blind, then enter.
tasks: Buy max flashes (skip rifles if needed)
Chain-flash banana and site non-stop
Enter only while flashes are popping
Plant fast, hold with whatever guns remain

strats.description: Single-file through apps. Stay clumped.
tasks: Line up in apps balcony order
Walk in as one clump
First death: the next two swing instantly
Plant for library / pit

strats.description: Four banana, one A. Punish the banana rush.
tasks: Four hold banana / sandbags / new box
One soft A apps
Util dump on first banana sound
No mid peek until info

strats.description: Sprint outside. No secret, no ramp first.
tasks: Five outside on go
Smoke main / garage if anyone has it
Contact heaven and hut together
Decide A roof or ramp only after first fight

strats.description: Ignore outside. Everyone ramp.
tasks: All five ramp / silo
Flash lower, trade into dark
No one checks outside
Plant for ramp, stack lower

strats.description: Stack heaven. If they never go outside, whatever.
tasks: Three heaven / hut
One ramp, one secret soft
Save AWP for outside cross
Fall together only on plant

strats.description: Knives through lobby until someone gets a slash. Then guns.
tasks: Knives out through lobby / silo
No shooting until a knife or Zeus kill
After opener frag: full spray go A or ramp
Plant wherever the fight broke

strats.description: Skip mid. Dive donut as five.
tasks: Rush donut together
Flash cave / temple on entry
No split, all donut
Plant for donut, hold cave

strats.description: Full cave to B. Util optional.
tasks: Five through cave / lane to B
One flash for site
Trade elbow and ruins together
Plant for cave

strats.description: Live on red / A. B can wait until you hear plant.
tasks: Four A / red / donut
One B soft only
Util dump donut on contact
Retake B as a pack if needed

strats.description: Negevs take mid. Hold W and spray the door.
tasks: Buy Negev / M249 if possible
Hold W into mid
Spray door and elbow without stopping
After mid: hit the quieter site

strats.description: Crouch-walk water quiet, then hit site together.
tasks: Crouch-walk water as five
No running until first contact
Flash palace / site together
Plant for water, hold connector soft

strats.description: Double-smoke their choke and plant behind it.
tasks: Wait for CT smoke on A entry
Throw your smoke into theirs
Plant behind the smoke wall
Swing out only after plant

strats.description: Win mid first. No site hit until you own it.
tasks: All five contest mid / bridge
No A or B until mid kill or space
After mid: pick a site
Bomb carrier stays mid until called

strats.description: Play heaven / camera. Force them to look up.
tasks: Two heaven / camera
Two A site soft
One B
Save util for water push

strats.description: Checkers to B. No mid lurk.
tasks: Five through checkers / highway
Flash site, spray headshot
Plant for checkers
Hold together, no hero peeks

strats.description: Four A main, one late mid for the flank.
tasks: Four rush A main
One late mid / Z for flank
Flash site, plant default
Lurk only peeks after plant

strats.description: Three mid. Fight for mid like it's your ego.
tasks: Three mid / Z / garage
One A, one B soft
First mid duel decides rotations
No site stack until mid dies

strats.description: Pistols only. Five Glocks rush long together.
tasks: Pistols only, no rifles
Rush long doors together
Flash long, spray pit / site
Plant for long, swing CT

strats.description: Deagles only. One-taps or you lose.
tasks: Buy Deagle only (armor optional)
Play for headshots, no spray rifles
Default mid info then hit a site
Commit even if the first shots miss

strats.description: No guns until someone lands a Zeus or knife. Then go.
tasks: Buy Zeus if you can
Close-range hunt for the opener zap
After first Zeus/knife kill: guns free
Hit the nearest site as five

strats.description: Shotguns on B. Make them walk into you.
tasks: B players buy shotguns
Hold close tunnels / car angles
No long peeks, make them come in
A side plays normal soft

strats.description: Spam decoys. Fake everything.
tasks: Buy decoys over utility if broke
Decoy mid and apps early
Fake rotate on every decoy
Hold real angles after the third fake

strats.description: Nobody buys. Pistols only this round.
tasks: No purchases (keep leftover util only)
Play close angles together
Stack the likely hit site
Don't force a gun

strats.description: Dual Berettas only. Spray into B.
tasks: Buy Dual Berettas
Rush B / water together
Spray site entry as a pack
Plant for water

strats.description: One buy each this round. Gun or util or armor.
tasks: One buy each (gun OR util OR armor)
Default mid for info
Hit the site with the most space
Trade hard

strats.description: Single file through tunnels. Nobody peeks off the line.
tasks: Line up at T spawn, one behind the other
Walk tunnels as a snake, no spreading
Front player flashes, everyone follows in
Plant for tunnels, stay stacked

strats.description: Conga line through underpass and apps. Follow the front guy.
tasks: Single file into underpass
Stay glued through apps, no mid lurk
Front flashes site, train piles in
Plant for apps

strats.description: Banana snake. One path, five bodies, zero originality.
tasks: Line up toward banana
Walk sandbags as a single file
Front flashes, the rest trade in order
Plant for banana

strats.description: Outside as a conga line. No secret splits, just follow.
tasks: Single file out of lobby to outside
Stay in line past silo / garage
Front contacts heaven, snake piles up
Hit A roof or ramp only after the stack arrives

strats.description: Cave snake into B. Elbow is the choke, stay in file.
tasks: Line up into cave / lane
Walk elbow as five in a row
Front flashes site, follow and trade
Plant for cave

strats.description: Water snake. Crouch-walk the line, then pile site.
tasks: Single file into water
Crouch-walk until first contact
Flash palace / site, enter in order
Plant for water

strats.description: Checkers snake to B. Highway is a hallway for a reason.
tasks: Line up into checkers
Walk highway single file
Front flashes site, snake enters
Plant for checkers
